label: Leibniz defended innate ideas: Nothing in the intellect without senses, except intellect itself
description: Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz formulated a fundamental critique of "Tabula Rasa (The Blank Slate)", challenging its coherence and proposing an alternative model.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "Tabula Rasa (The Blank Slate)".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the Early Modern & Scientific.
